# IDS Model Check

> Free, MIT-licensed checker for buildingSMART IDS 1.0 (Information Delivery Specification) files against IFC building models (IFC2X3, IFC4, IFC4X3). Runs in the browser with nothing uploaded, or as a dependency-free Node command line. Exports BCF 2.1 issues, CSV and JSON.

- Page: https://marisstella.app/ids-model-check/
- Source: https://github.com/Duncan-Haywood/oss-monorepo/tree/main/ventures/ids-model-check
- Accuracy: 334 of 334 of buildingSMART's IDS test pairs (suite commit 870f9c4, 2026-09-25); same verdicts and failing elements as IfcTester on five real models, except multiple xs:pattern restrictions, where it follows XSD and the suite (patterns are alternatives).

## Use

- Browser: drop a .ifc and a .ids, read each specification's result and the failing elements, download BCF/CSV/JSON.
- CLI: `node cli.mjs model.ifc spec.ids [--json] [--bcf out.bcfzip]`; exit 0 all pass, 1 a specification fails or is invalid, 2 error.
- IDS audit with no model: `node cli.mjs --audit spec.ids` (or "Audit the IDS only" on the page) reports specifications that are invalid against the IFC schema: unknown or lower-case classes, attributes a class lacks or has only as derived/inverse, values compared with lists/objects/selects, malformed numbers, integers and booleans, patterns on numbers, unknown dataTypes, prohibited specifications with requirements. Flags 26 of buildingSMART's 27 invalid IDS test files and none of the 307 valid ones.
- Library: `checkIds(idsText, ifcText, {schemas, typeMap, measureUnits})` in ids.mjs; `check(idsText, ifcText)` in node.mjs.

## Covers

- Facets: entity (with predefined type), attribute, property (and quantities, material properties, predefined property sets), classification (with parent references), material (layers, profiles, constituents, lists), partOf (aggregates, groups, containment, nests, voids, fills).
- Restrictions: enumeration, pattern (XSD, anchored), min/max inclusive/exclusive, length, minLength, maxLength.
- IDS 1e-6 float tolerance; values converted to SI from project or property units; IFC2X3 occurrence classes via the type mapping table.

## Not covered

- ifcXML, ifcJSON, .ifczip input; property set template checks in the audit; geometry or clash checks (IDS does not specify them).

Results are a reading of the model against the IDS, not a design review or professional advice.
